claim: A two-step formula to produce human text from chatGPT
summary: Not sure how ZeroGPT, got all the good press about a 22 year old making a detector, when there are many detectors on the market, some free, and some by OpenAI itself. I contend my two step method beats them all. If you find something that does not work using this two-step process, send it to me. I'll be happy to see what I can learn from it.
